summary.text: As of 15 June 2026, Northwind Cloud Services retains standard enterprise customer data for 24 months after contract termination, while backups are governed separately under the Backup Retention Schedule and retained for 35 days. For European Union customers, the retention period is 12 months for accounts opened before 1 January 2026, and 18 months for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026 pursuant to signed Amendment A (effective 1 March 2026). Operational records—including the system-of-record export and the public trust page—have not yet been updated and still display a stale 12-month period for all EU accounts, though signed Amendment A is the controlling authority. A proposed Draft Amendment B to increase EU retention to 24 months remains unsigned and has no effect.

summary.text: As of 15 June 2026, Amendment A sets EU retention at 18 months for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026, effective 1 March 2026; earlier-opened EU accounts remain at 12 months. Standard retention is 24 months, while backups are retained for 35 days and are governed separately. Draft Amendment B is unsigned and unapproved, and the system export and public trust page do not reflect Amendment A for 2026 accounts.
